name: Velvet Snake
description: A slow little appetite. A growing little problem.
mechanic: Steer a grid snake to gather twelve berries without touching walls or its own tail.
rules: Collect 12 berries to finish your garden walk.
Every berry grows your snake. Walls and your own tail end the walk.
Choose your direction early. You cannot turn straight back into yourself.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD; tap the four direction buttons.

name: Rally Club
mechanic: Paddle versus an imperfect opponent; win five points before the computer.
rules: Move your paddle to return the ball. First to five wins.
Hit nearer a paddle edge to send a sharper angle.
Your opponent reacts slowly. Change the angle to find an opening.
controls: Up/Down or W/S; drag on the court, or hold the direction buttons.

name: Paper Links
description: Three tiny greens. A patient line.
mechanic: Aim and power a friction-driven golf ball through three obstacle courses.
rules: Sink a ball on each of three miniature greens.
Drag from the ball toward your target: farther means stronger.
Use the walls to bank. Finish all greens within 12 strokes.
controls: Drag from the ball then release; Left/Right aim, Up/Down power, Space shoots.

name: Moon Basket
description: Put a soft arc into the evening.
mechanic: Adjust a ballistic shot to pass downward through a basketball hoop.
rules: Make three baskets in eight shots.
Adjust the launch angle and strength before each shot.
The ball must travel down through the hoop. A higher arc helps.
controls: Left/Right angle, Up/Down strength; Space or Shoot. Drag upward from the ball to aim.

name: Quiet Curl
mechanic: Aim and send three curling stones across friction ice to score proximity points.
rules: Send three stones toward the house.
A stone inside the outer ring earns points; the center earns most.
Score at least 120 total. Your stones can bump one another.
controls: Left/Right aim, Up/Down strength; Space or Release. Drag toward the target to aim.

name: Kite Flight
description: A ribbon of air between the rooftops.
mechanic: Hold-to-rise and release-to-fall flying through ten scrolling gates.
rules: Guide your kite through ten openings.
Hold Lift to rise; let go to glide down.
Touching a gate or the top/bottom ends the flight.
controls: Hold Space, the Lift button, or the sky; release to glide.

name: Soft Landing
description: A small engine. A softer arrival.
mechanic: Rotate and thrust a lunar craft, managing velocity and fuel to land safely.
rules: Land on the striped pad, upright and gently.
Use thrust to slow your descent; tilt to drift sideways.
Touch down below 32 vertical speed and 22 sideways speed, within about 13 degrees of upright.
controls: Left/Right rotate; hold Space or Thrust. Speed and fuel are shown below the sky.

name: Star Tow
description: Bring the strays back to their star.
mechanic: Steer an inertial spacecraft to pick up three cargo pods and deliver each to a central dock.
rules: Touch a gold pod to tow it. Carry one at a time.
Bring it into the central dock slowly (below 70 speed).
Deliver all three before the 60-second shift ends. Coast and brake to turn.
controls: Left/Right rotate, Space thrust, Down brake; use on-screen controls.

name: Garden Guard
description: A kindly eye for a busy patch.
mechanic: Selectively tap emerging pests while leaving flowers untouched.
rules: Tap striped pests when they emerge. Leave flowers alone.
Catch 12 pests during a 30-second shift.
Three flower taps end the shift. Missing a pest only costs time.
controls: Tap a garden square; keys1–9 select squares.

name: Beat Post
description: Sort the night mail to a little rhythm.
mechanic: Hit three lanes as scheduled notes cross a timing line.
rules: Sort 24 notes by hitting their lane at the delivery line.
Near-perfect hits earn more points. Eight misses end the round.
Deliver at least 18 notes. There is no audio requirement; follow the visual pulse.
controls: Left/Down/Right or A/S/D; tap the three lane buttons.

name: Pinball Pocket
description: A whole arcade in your coat pocket.
mechanic: Operate two flippers to bounce a ball into bumpers while avoiding the drain.
rules: Light the bumpers to earn 1,000 points.
Hold the left and right flippers to bounce a low ball back up.
You have three balls. Hold one flipper while launching to aim toward that side. Side gutters stay open.
controls: Left/Right or A/D hold flippers; on-screen flipper buttons. Space launches a ball.

name: Rope Skip
description: A little hop. A little grace.
mechanic: Jump a character over periodic rope sweeps; landed recovery prevents spam.
rules: Clear 16 rope sweeps to finish.
Jump as the rope approaches your feet.
Three catches end the session. Let your feet land before jumping again.
controls: Space or Jump; the moving rope and countdown arc show the approach.

name: Table Bowls
description: A tidy table, a satisfying clack.
mechanic: Shoot a cue ball into three object balls and pocket them within eight shots.
rules: Pocket all three colored balls in eight shots.
Aim the white cue ball; drag farther for more power.
Only shoot when every ball stops. A scratched cue ball returns to the start.
controls: Drag from white ball; Left/Right aim, Up/Down strength, Space shoots.

name: Balance Beam
description: Keep your center while the world tilts.
mechanic: Lean a beam to counter a moving breeze and keep a rolling marble on the platform.
rules: Keep the marble on the beam for 30 seconds.
Tilt left or right to bring the marble back. Its weight tips the beam farther as it drifts.
Gentle corrections beat big swings. Falling off ends the balance.
controls: Left/Right or A/D; hold the on-screen tilt controls.

name: Harbor Catch
description: A patient line beneath the harbor.
mechanic: Position a boat, lower a hook into patrolling fish at different depths, then reel a catch aboard within eight casts.
rules: Land three fish within eight casts. Move the boat before you lower your line.
Hold Cast to lower the hook. Release to reel it back; a hooked fish reels in automatically.
Fish patrol different depths. Predict their path; touching the seabed wastes your cast.
controls: Left/Right or drag to move the boat while the hook is up. Hold Space or Cast to lower; release to reel.
